owners: Carousel owns the single selection and borrowed image list
ImageContainer owns the Canvas, temporary composed buffer and cancellable timer
cases: Caller list and image identities are retained; disposing the carousel does not dispose caller images
Programmatic setSelection emits no selection event and invalid arguments leave selection unchanged
User navigation wraps; listener observes the new selection synchronously after slide preparation
Real Canvas pixels preserve unscaled centering and clipped damage
Original left/right two-viewport slide uses 200ms first and 50ms subsequent scheduling with minimum one-pixel progress
An overlapping slide cancels the former timer and its stale generation cannot change the new animation
Hidden, empty and outside-window presentation produces no Canvas drawing; hidden navigation retains semantic selection
Revealing a hidden owner refreshes the selected image
Dispose during an animation cancels pending timer work, releases owned buffer pixels and prevents deferred repaint
Resize validates the bounded viewport before mutating Canvas dimensions
browser_profile_boundary: Ready positive-size ImageElements, CSS pixel ratio 1:1 with no transforms; explicit refresh after external ancestor visibility/layout changes. GWT browser execution is required. SWT API/native and RAP integration are separate open gates.
